fields.description: The Archive by Imtiaz is designed around reading, with a residential library, quiet corners and furnished homes. Pools, floating cabanas, a gym and an outdoor cinema provide shared leisure spaces.

sources.label: The Archive · 43-page plans and unit types
Property Finder · The Archive project reference

overview: Plans contain 26 variants: four studios, fourteen one-bedroom, six two-bedroom and two three-bedroom. Room dimensions are printed; whole-home totals are absent.
research.locationNote: Property Finder identifies Dubai Land Residence Complex; the developer describes road access but publishes no street address in its page text.
research.priceNote: Release references: studio AED 666,000; one-bedroom AED 979,000; two-bedroom AED 1.55 million; three-bedroom AED 1.8 million. Confirm current quotations.
research.paymentNote: Alternative: 60% before handover, 40% across three years. Printed 3.3% quarterly totals 39.6% across twelve instalments; confirm the balancing payment. DLD/admin fees are additional.
research.handoverNote: Brochure/payment target Q3 2028 matches Property Finder’s September 2028. Mitchell’s separately attributes December 2028 to a dated register extract; the forecasts differ.
unresolved: Starting-size measurement basis is unstated. Balcony size varies by location; do not calculate contractual totals from room dimensions.
Current inventory, service charges, final furniture specification and certified completion remain unverified. Images remain illustrative.
